description: Change one website issue (an action plan; cloud only) the way a person does in the dashboard: its status (open, in_progress, resolved, dismissed for a close as not planned that stays closed, wontfix), its assignee (the user id of a member of the organization; null clears it) and its severity. Needs the audits:write scope and an owner, admin or editor role, like the dashboard. Set only the fields to change; at least one is required. A status change moves the issue's findings with it exactly as in the dashboard (a completed close releases them, a reopen re-links them), and a closed issue stays closed when a later audit runs: triage does not reopen what a person closed as not planned. A severity edit on a triage issue locks its priority against the next triage run. Closing a real problem as not planned hides it from the tracker: only do it when the user said so. The result is the issue as it reads afterwards.

assigned_to.description: User id of an organization member to assign to; null clears the assignee.

severity.description: New severity (a triage issue's priority follows and is locked).

website_id.description: Website id the issue belongs to.
